<module id="alu">
    <description>ALU for a 32-bit MIPS-ISA CPU.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">32-bit input operand A.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">32-bit input operand B.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit control signal for selecting the operation to be performed.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">32-bit output representing the result of the operation.</output>
        <output id="zero">1-bit output indicating whether the result is zero.</output>
        <output id="carry">1-bit output indicating whether a carry occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="negative">1-bit output indicating whether the result is negative.</output>
        <output id="overflow">1-bit output indicating whether an overflow occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="flag">1-bit output representing a general flag, which is set based on specific operations (SLT and SLTU).</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="ADD">6'b100000</parameter>
        <parameter id="ADDU">6'b100001</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUB">6'b100010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUBU">6'b100011</parameter>
        <parameter id="AND">6'b100100</parameter>
        <parameter id="OR">6'b100101</parameter>
        <parameter id="XOR">6'b100110</parameter>
        <parameter id="NOR">6'b100111</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLT">6'b101010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLTU">6'b101011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLL">6'b000000</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRL">6'b000010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRA">6'b000011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLLV">6'b000100</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRLV">6'b000110</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRAV">6'b000111</parameter>
        <parameter id="LUI">6'b001111</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <signal id="res" width_description="[63:0]" type="wire">Result register.</signal>
        <signal id="shift_amount" width_description="[4:0]" type="wire">Shift amount.</signal>
        <signal id="signed_a" width_description="[31:0]" type="wire">Signed version of a.</signal>
        <signal id="signed_b" width_description="[31:0]" type="wire">Signed version of b.</signal>
        <signal id="unsigned_a" width_description="[31:0]" type="wire">Unsigned version of a.</signal>
        <signal id="unsigned_b" width_description="[31:0]" type="wire">Unsigned version of b.</signal>
        <signal id="temp_result" width_description="[31:0]" type="wire">Temporary result.</signal>
        <signal id="temp_flag" type="wire">Temporary flag.</signal>
        <assign>signed_a = $signed(a);</assign>
        <assign>signed_b = $signed(b);</assign>
        <assign>unsigned_a = unsigned(a);</assign>
        <assign>unsigned_b = unsigned(b);</assign>
        <always @(*)>
            case (aluc)
                ADD: temp_result = signed_a + signed_b;
                ADDU: temp_result = unsigned_a + unsigned_b;
                SUB: temp_result = signed_a - signed_b;
                SUBU: temp_result = unsigned_a - unsigned_b;
                AND: temp_result = a & b;
                OR: temp_result = a | b;
                XOR: temp_result = a ^ b;
                NOR: temp_result = ~(a | b);
                SLT: begin
                    temp_result = signed_a < signed_b ? 1 : 0;
                    temp_flag = 1;
                end
                SLTU: begin
                    temp_result = unsigned_a < unsigned_b ? 1 : 0;
                    temp_flag = 1;
                end
                SLL: begin
                    shift_amount = a[4:0];
                    temp_result = {32'b0, a} << shift_amount;
                end
                SRL: begin
                    shift_amount = a[4:0];
                    temp_result = {32'b0, a} >> shift_amount;
                end
                SRA: begin
                    shift_amount = a[4:0];
                    temp_result = a >> shift_amount;
                end
                SLLV: begin
                    shift_amount = a[4:0];
                    temp_result = {32'b0, a} << b[4:0];
                end
                SRLV: begin
                    shift_amount = a[4:0];
                    temp_result = {32'b0, a} >> b[4:0];
                end
                SRAV: begin
                    shift_amount = a[4:0];
                    temp_result = a >> b[4:0];
                end
                LUI: temp_result = {a[15:0], 16'b0};
                default: temp_result = 32'bZ;
            endcase
            r = temp_result;
            zero = temp_result == 32'b0 ? 1 : 0;
            carry = temp_result[31];
            negative = temp_result[31];
            overflow = (aluc == ADD || aluc == SUB) && ((signed_a[31] == signed_b[31]) != (signed_a[31] == temp_result[31]));
            flag = temp_flag;
        </always>
    </logic_description>
</module>
